_comment: Phase 19 groups its capstones into tracks that prerequisite strings refer to ('Track B foundations'). Upstream has no machine-readable table for this, so the ranges below were read off the lesson folder names. The source text is inconsistent (it calls both 20-29 and 30-37 'Track B foundations'), which is why edges built from a bare track reference get confidence 'low'. Edit freely; the build never overwrites this file.

B.title: GPT from scratch in PyTorch
B.note: 30-37 are the 'foundations' (tokenizer to pretrained weights); 38-41 fine-tuning and eval
